notes: Three tables describe a room's two live BG layers: gForegroundTilemaps[mapDataIdx] (playfield size + tilemap only), gForegroundInfo[pixelDataIdx] (playfield tileset + tile animations), gForegroundPalettes[paletteDataIdx] (playfield palette + palette animations), and gRoomTiledBGs[backgroundIdx] (the background layer: everything in one RoomTiledBG).

Playfield tileset is LZ77-decompressed to char block 2 (0x06008000); background tileset to char block 0 (0x06000000). Playfield tilemap is LZ77-decompressed to EWRAM; background tilemap is used in place (uncompressed u16 screen entries).
A 'room id' tail field (RoomTiledBG.unk1C high half, ForegroundInfo.roomId, ForegroundPalette.roomId) is an authoring annotation the engine never reads: the first room that uses the entry.

records.description: A tiled BG layer. In gForegroundTilemaps only width, height, tilemap and unk1C are filled (tiles/palette come from ForegroundInfo/ForegroundPalette); in gRoomTiledBGs all fields are used. Copied whole into LevelInfo.unk180[layer] at room load.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Layer width in 8-px tiles. For the playfield this defines the room width: roomWidth = width*8 px (collision stride width/2).

evidence.data: collision size == width/2 * height/2 in 286/286 rooms

fields.name: height
fields.description: Layer height in 8-px tiles (room height for the playfield).

fields.name: animFrameSize
fields.description: Bytes of tile graphics per animation frame for whole-tileset animation (sub_08153CB8): frame f is read at tileset + tilesetSize + (f-1)*animFrameSize. 0 in every room layer: the path is unused by rooms (the playfield animates through ForegroundInfo instead).

fields.name: animFrameCount
fields.description: Number of whole-tileset animation frames; 0 disables the animation.

fields.name: animFrameDelay
fields.description: Frames between animation steps (compared with a pre-incremented counter: 0 and 1 both mean every frame).

fields.name: tileset
fields.description: LZ77-compressed 4bpp tileset (background layer; decompressed to 0x06000000). 0 in gForegroundTilemaps.

fields.name: tilesetTiles
fields.description: Declared 'in tiles'. For room layers it is 900 in every background (= the tile capacity below the playfield char block) and 0 in gForegroundTilemaps; the room loader ignores it (LZ77 carries its own size). Only the dead whole-tileset animation path adds it to a byte address. The same offset in the generic TiledBg_082D7850 view (menus) is a DMA byte count.

evidence.note: generic view: byte count queued for DMA

evidence.data: 900 in 33/33 backgrounds used by rooms, including 30x320 and 32x22 ones

fields.name: palette
fields.description: BG palette colours (BGR555; bit 15 is used as a flag by some palettes). 0 in gForegroundTilemaps.

fields.name: paletteOffset
fields.description: Destination colour index in BG palette RAM (96 = bank 6 for every room background).

fields.name: paletteSize
fields.description: Number of colours (128 = 8 banks for every room background).

fields.name: tilemap
fields.description: u16 screen entries, width*height of them. Playfield: LZ77-compressed (decompressed to gUnk_02028EE0[slot]); background: raw.

fields.name: formatAndRoom
fields.description: Two u16s. Low half: tilemap element width for the playfield (0 = u16 entries; non-zero = u8 entries, read by sub_080015A8; 0 everywhere, the u8 path is dead, paired with the dead cell_record_patch8). High half: authoring room id (the room the entry was made for), never read by the engine.

evidence.data: gForegroundTilemaps[mapDataIdx].unk1C >> 16 == roomId in 286/286 rooms; backgrounds hold their first user's id (e.g. 0x1FE = 510 for cabbage_cavern_1)

records.description: Playfield tileset plus looping tile animations that overwrite parts of char block 2 (sub_080021E4 each frame).

fields.name: tileset
fields.description: LZ77 4bpp tileset, decompressed to 0x06008000.

fields.name: animGfx
fields.description: Uncompressed tile graphics that animation frames copy from (frame gfxOffset is added to it).

fields.name: anims
fields.description: Array of numAnims foreground_anim records.

fields.name: numAnims
fields.description: Number of tile animations.

fields.name: authorRoomId
fields.description: Authoring annotation; not read.

evidence.data: plausible room ids; no reader in game/src

records.description: One looping tile animation: every frame-duration, copy numChunks chunks of copySize bytes from animGfx+frame.gfxOffset to char block 2 + vramOffset, both advancing by stride.

fields.name: vramOffset
fields.description: Destination offset from 0x06008000 (tile-aligned).

fields.name: copySize
fields.description: Bytes per chunk (multiples of 32 = whole 4bpp tiles).

fields.name: chunkStride
fields.description: Added to source and destination after each chunk (0x400 = one 32-tile row).

fields.name: frames
fields.description: Array of numFrames foreground_anim_frame.

fields.name: numFrames
fields.description: Frame index wraps here (2, 3, 4 or 8 in retail).

fields.name: numChunks
fields.description: Chunk count per frame copy (1 or 2 in retail).

records.description: One frame of a tile animation.

fields.name: gfxOffset
fields.description: Offset into ForegroundInfo.animGfx.

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Hold time of this frame (1..10 in retail).

records.description: Playfield palette plus looping palette animations (sub_08003108). Manifest kind fg_palette.

fields.name: palette
fields.description: 6 banks x 16 BGR555 colours for the playfield.

fields.name: anims
fields.description: Array of numAnims pointers to foreground_palette_anim.

fields.name: authorRoomId
fields.description: Authoring annotation; not read.

records.description: A palette animation: cycle through numFrames palette frames ({const u16 *colors; u16 duration} records, same layout as struct Unk_08D6DCAC), writing paletteSize colours at paletteOffset.

fields.name: frames
fields.description: Array of pointers to {colors, duration} frame records. A frame duration of 999 marks the animation as disabled (tested, with an original-code indexing quirk: it tests frame[i] where i is the animation index).

evidence.note: u16 at +4 of the frame record = duration

fields.name: numFramesAndOffset
fields.description: [0] = numFrames (0 disables), [1] = paletteOffset in colours into BG palette RAM.

packed.name: numFrames
packed.description: frame index wraps here; 0 = animation off

fields.name: paletteSize
fields.description: Colours written per frame.
